plugin.name: Images by Not_Found
plugin.description:
In-chat image generation engine — illustrates every character post.

- **Auto mode**: pictures for new posts automatically, for all posts, or manually via the ↻ button under a post
- **A separate model writes the prompt** — the chat model or your own connection; a library of style guides (Wlop, Novel AI, comics, pencil and more) plus your own prompts
- **Appearance references**: character and persona avatars, custom photo and text refs; refs are compressed on the wire, models without image input get appearance as tags
- **Connections**: any OpenAI-compatible API (gateways/routers), Gemini native, Naistera
- **Chat gallery** with favorites ⭐, downloads and memory cleanup; per-post buttons: regenerate, edit prompt, refine image, upscale
- **Resilience**: network and provider retries, workarounds for finicky router filters, an error log with honest human explanations

All settings live in the in-chat Images panel.

**Credits and acknowledgements**

Tavo adaptation: NotFound_404 / Not_Found.
Engine: [Aceenvw](https://github.com/aceeenvw/notsosillynotsoimages), [0xl0cal](https://github.com/0xl0cal/sillyimages); references and features: tizenry / Raven generation, TensorAI, [Monblant / extblocks](https://gitgud.io/Monblant/extblocks).
Boards were inspired by the wardrobe in [MommyCat / delidgi's project](https://github.com/delidgi/sillyimages).
Embedded prompts and styles: [Aceenvw](https://t.me/aceeenvw), [Kamoi / Nesquik Duo](https://nufahi.github.io/nesquik-duo/), [Rakshakti](https://t.me/rakshaktigiggles), Ksyu & Travadd, [Shino](https://t.me/ah_ah_shino4ka).
Thanks to [@tavvvvoooosty](https://t.me/tavvvvoooosty) and Shino for permission to include the NovelAI comic prompt.
[Full credits and links](https://github.com/NotFound404dev/tavo-images/blob/main/CREDITS.md). Code: AGPL-3.0-or-later.
